decided_by: User at the M33.3-R S5 touchpoint (2026-09-27); recorded exactly in docs/plans/M33_3_R_STATE.md section 6

user_decisions.validator: Reopen S1 allowlist: bounded amendment S1-A1 (closed-class function words and generic clarification verbs only)
user_decisions.latency_tolerance: warm p95 <= 1.5 s for model-worded clarifications
user_decisions.fallback_tolerance: a model tier counts as qualified only if its fallback rate is <= 25%
user_decisions.wording_preference: Template is fine: template wording is acceptable as primary; no noticeable-improvement gate

production_config.selection_basis: best overall exploratory round-2 acceptance under the amended validator (constrained decoding: 0 invented slots, 100% schema-valid); chosen before the final run

qualification_rule.rows: production_config rows of the tier's arm for that need class, all repeats

simple_class_rule: SIMPLE is always the validated template (Plan A R2.5); no model tier is gated for SIMPLE
unqualified_tier_rule: a need class whose tier fails keeps the validated template (EXPLAIN) or a template limitation/hand-off statement (REASONING); nothing is weakened

s8_parameters.latency_penalty_basis: reward falls by 1.0 at the User's 1.5 s tolerance

disclosures: REASONING has 3 contracts (6 rows with 2 repeats); a verdict on it is statistically weak and is reported as such.
The S1-A1 allowlist and the prompt v3 choice used exploratory evidence; the thresholds above are the User's, not derived from final results.
